description: This file defines a mock class ServiceMock for the WPEFramework plugin system, subclassing IShell. It utilizes Google Mock to create mock implementations for the IShell interface methods, enabling unit testing of components dependent on this interface.

classes.name: ServiceMock
classes.description: A mock class for the WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell interface, used for unit testing.
